legend.published: Stated on the caterer's public site.
legend.assumption: Not published; a documented classroom assumption.

pickup.label: Pick Up
notes: Published: for orders of 10 guests or more.
Pickup lead time is not published; 24 hours is assumed.

delivery.label: Delivery Service

order_minimum.note: The FAQ states a 20-guest minimum; the catering page states a $400 order minimum. Both are enforced.

included: Complimentary paper goods and plastic cutlery on request
notes: Published: for delivery orders of $400 or more.
Delivery fee and radius are not published; see delivery below.

full_service.label: Full Service
included: One or more dedicated Catering Team Members for three hours
Choice of black or white linens
Chafing dishes and pewter serving bowls
Buffet-style service, setup, serving, and breakdown
customer_provides: Two 6-8 foot tables, or similar space, for each buffet line requested
notes: Published: for orders of 30 guests or more.
Published: one week notice, with the final order confirmed no later than 48 hours before the event.

dine_in.label: Dine-In Catering
notes: Published: for orders of 20 guests or more.
Hosted at a Stonefire Grill location, buffet-style, with a dedicated server.

fee.reason: The caterer does not publish a delivery fee. A flat $65 within 15 miles plus $2.50 per mile beyond that is a simple, defensible LA-area model.

radius.reason: No published radius. The caterer is in Torrance; 25 miles covers the core LA basin including Culver City.

origin.note: Prices are valid for the Torrance location only.

full_service.reason: Full-service pricing is quote-based and not published. 18% is a common LA catering service charge.

attendants.reason: The caterer includes a team member for three hours but does not publish labor rates. One attendant per 30 guests at $35/hour with a three-hour minimum is a defensible model.

gratuity.note: Gratuity is optional and not required. If added, keep it separate from the tax base.

tax.taxable_base_reason: Mandatory delivery and service charges are treated as taxable. Gratuity is excluded. Confirm with the caterer or a CPA for production use.
notes: The rate follows the delivery address, not the caterer's city.
Culver City and Torrance rates are from the CDTFA table effective October 1, 2026.
Catering packages are served buffet style with freshly baked breadsticks and priced per person.
Signature selections are served with breadsticks and choice of two signature sides.
SFG Best includes any four signature or premium salads, sides, or pastas.
Minimum order of 10 for each boxed meal selection.

children.counting_rule: two children under 10 count as one adult
children.reason: Published in the catering FAQ as a headcount suggestion.

payment.charge_timing: The card on file is charged the full amount the day before the event.

cancellation.policy: Not published. Confirm with the caterer before sending a quote.

notes: The caterer warns that any item may come into contact with animal products during preparation.
GF on the menu means gluten-sensitive, not gluten-free.
Allergen data is per the public allergen table; items without a match are marked unknown.

capacity.note: The capacity calendar is invented for the demo and is not part of the caterer's published rules.

assumptions: Display name is anonymized to 'Sample Catering Co.'; prices and items remain real.
Delivery fee: $65 flat within 15 miles, then $2.50 per mile to a 25-mile maximum.
Full-service service charge: 18% of food subtotal.
Full-service staffing: $35 per attendant-hour, 3-hour minimum, 1 attendant per 30 guests.
Delivery minimum: enforce both the published 20-guest minimum and the published $400 subtotal minimum.
Tax base includes food, delivery, service charge, and staffing; gratuity is excluded.
Package side upgrades and extra sides are priced per person.
Serving counts for piece-count items are estimated at 2-3 pieces per guest.
GF is treated as gluten-sensitive, not gluten-free.
Missing allergen rows are unknown, never none.
Package and boxed-meal allergens depend on selections and require caterer confirmation.
